state.catalog_rule: Feedback is of kind comment, change_request or validated and records author, time, target record version and kind at admission; a posted entry is never edited, a correction is a new entry linking back to the original, and revoking access never rewrites past attribution. The catalog is silent on whether corrections or responses may follow resolution.

code_behavior.materialize: Materialize refuses with Validation and appends no event when the kind is outside comment/change_request/validated, the contribution tenant/program/handoff/feedback differs from the thread, the record id is empty, or the record version id is empty with no selected native source. A second materialization returns Conflict with no event.
code_behavior.after_resolution: Resolve a second time returns Conflict. Correct and Respond after resolution are still accepted at the current revision and advance the revision by one; no test asserts either way.
code_behavior.tests: Tests: kind theory (approval, empty, Comment) refused with no event; foreign feedback/handoff/tenant refused with no event; empty record or version refused; foreign stream refused; second materialize Conflict with one fact; unmaterialized PrepareWrite/PrepareResolve NotFound; stale and ahead revision Conflict after replayed facts; resolved twice Conflict; empty or mismatched correction id refused with no event; missing expected revision refused; replay of correct, respond, resolve keeps original contribution and revision 4.

corrections_after_resolution.instructions: For state.code_behavior.after_resolution, should this aggregate stage change behavior for Correct/Respond after resolution given the catalog text?

criteria.leave_unchanged_record_open_question: Keep current behavior, record an open product question, assert nothing.
criteria.refuse_now: Refuse corrections and responses after resolution now.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: Only the product owner can decide.

materialize_validation_consistent.instructions: The Materialize validations in state.code_behavior.materialize are consistent with state.catalog_rule (kind set, exact record version attribution) and do not invent a rule beyond it.

tests_assert_invariant.instructions: The tests in state.code_behavior.tests assert behavioral outcomes (refusal kind, no appended fact, revision after replay) that cover the catalog rule and the stated code behavior.
